spec: Let users retrieve a saved preference without changing existing behavior. Keep the change small and cover the supported and missing-value cases. Do not redesign unrelated settings.

tasks.title: Read a saved preference
tasks.body:
Implement the smallest change using existing storage and validation patterns.

## Acceptance criteria
- Saved values are returned unchanged.
- Missing values follow the existing default behavior.
- Focused tests cover both cases.

tasks.title: Use the preference in its existing consumer
tasks.body:
Connect the approved read behavior to the existing consumer without redesigning it.

## Acceptance criteria
- The consumer uses the saved preference.
- Missing values preserve current behavior.
- Relevant checks pass or pre-existing failures are reported.
